message.content:
We use the Fibonacci recurrence

\[
F_{n+2}=F_{n+1}+F_n.
\]

Then

\[
F_{n+2}-F_n=F_{n+1}.
\]

So

\[
\frac{F_{n+1}}{F_nF_{n+2}}
=
\frac{F_{n+2}-F_n}{F_nF_{n+2}}
=
\frac{1}{F_n}-\frac{1}{F_{n+2}}.
\]

Therefore the sum telescopes:

\[
\sum_{n=1}^N \frac{F_{n+1}}{F_nF_{n+2}}
=
\sum_{n=1}^N \left(\frac{1}{F_n}-\frac{1}{F_{n+2}}\right).
\]

Writing out the terms,

\[
\left(\frac1{F_1}-\frac1{F_3}\right)
+\left(\frac1{F_2}-\frac1{F_4}\right)
+\left(\frac1{F_3}-\frac1{F_5}\right)
+\cdots
+\left(\frac1{F_N}-\frac1{F_{N+2}}\right).
\]

Most terms cancel, leaving

\[
\sum_{n=1}^N \frac{F_{n+1}}{F_nF_{n+2}}
=
\frac1{F_1}+\frac1{F_2}
-\frac1{F_{N+1}}-\frac1{F_{N+2}}.
\]

Since \(F_1=F_2=1\),

\[
\sum_{n=1}^N \frac{F_{n+1}}{F_nF_{n+2}}
=
2-\frac1{F_{N+1}}-\frac1{F_{N+2}}.
\]

Now let \(N\to\infty\). Since Fibonacci numbers grow without bound,

\[
\frac1{F_{N+1}}\to 0,
\qquad
\frac1{F_{N+2}}\to 0.
\]

Thus

\[
\sum_{n=1}^\infty \frac{F_{n+1}}{F_nF_{n+2}}
=
2.
\]

\[
\boxed{2}
\]
